Container.Name: rerinku-view
Container.Overview:
Rerinku View is a self-hosted NVR for IP cameras. It discovers ONVIF cameras or takes RTSP and GB28181 streams, shows live view in the browser with WebRTC, records continuously, plays back from a timeline, and can run object detection on the server. Video, recordings and detection results stay on your Unraid server. FFmpeg and the detection components are built in. No account is needed; an optional access password protects the console.
First start: open the WebUI, then add cameras under Devices. Set an access password under Settings before exposing the port beyond your LAN.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: nvr camera cctv onvif rtsp surveillance webrtc recording ipcam gb28181 detection
Container.Requires: Ports 8080 (console), 1883 (device MQTT) and 5060 (GB28181) must be free on the server, because the container uses host networking. An optional Intel or AMD GPU (/dev/dri) is used for hardware video decoding.
Container.Changes: Initial Unraid template for Rerinku View 0.1.1.
Container.License: Freeware, closed source. Bundles FFmpeg (GPLv3) and frp (Apache-2.0); notices are shown in the console under Settings, General, Third-party software.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Console and API (HTTP). With host networking this is the port the server listens on; to change it, also change HTTP_ADDR below.

Config.Name: Device MQTT Port
Config.Description: Broker that Rerinku cameras connect to. Informational with host networking.

Config.Name: GB28181 SIP Port (TCP)
Config.Description: GB28181 cameras register here. Informational with host networking.

Config.Name: GB28181 SIP Port (UDP)
Config.Description: GB28181 cameras register here. Informational with host networking.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Configuration, database, secret key and the bundled FFmpeg binaries. Keep this on a cache or SSD pool.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Where video recordings are stored. Use a share on the array or a large pool; it is handed to the PUID/PGID user on start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the server runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody. The appdata and recordings folders are handed to this user on start.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: HTTP_ADDR
Config.Description: Listen address of the console. Change the port here if 8080 is taken (for example :8090), then open the WebUI at that port.

Config.Name: GPU (optional)
Config.Description: Intel or AMD GPU for hardware video decoding. Set to /dev/dri to enable. Leave empty if the server has no GPU.
